title: Verify the indexed-context getter byte domain
changes: Add a controlled E170 comparison of the original context getter over all byte values and 0x100 aliases, plus three field-load instructions for all 33 records, with source bytes altered.
validation: Windows GNU build indexed-context-domain-build-nb7kbu5_ and Wine indexed-context-domain-wine-9l5p79sq pass 1024 getter and 198 field-instruction cases across interpreter and generated block dispatch, matching complete state and clock. Protected inputs pass, scratch removed and Wine drained.

Initial Wine dyn2l97k failed because the test object omitted called helper 019670; the corrected test includes it. Intervening build bv5plr0x completed compilation but its validation unit reported broken pipe after the terminal handle was interrupted; it is not accepted as evidence.
limitations: Controlled registers do not establish ordinary reachability, all callers, other high-byte aliases or the complete reader ABI; generated blocks can fall back to interpretation. Linux, USA, native Windows and performance remain open.
